name: How long does bathroom cabinet installation usually take?
description: Installation typically takes 1-3 days, but the overall project timeline is influenced by cabinet type, complexity, and material availability.

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom cabinet installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for bathroom cabinetry typically ranges from one to three days, depending on the scope of work. Simple replacements of existing cabinets can be quicker, while full renovations involving custom cabinetry or extensive modifications to plumbing and walls may take longer. Before installation begins, all materials must be ordered and received, which can add several weeks to the overall project schedule. We communicate clear timelines during the planning phase.
